big-news.text: North Sea oil topped $117 a barrel on Friday, the highest in about five months, after new tension in the Middle East. Equinor shares rose on the Oslo stock exchange.
The government wants the Oslofjord municipalities to build less along the shoreline, since only 30% of the inner Oslofjord is open to the public.
The Norwegian Editors' Association has given Hans Rustad, editor of the website Document, a formal warning.
Brunost is going to China. Tine, Norway's big dairy company, made its first batch for export there on Friday.

whats-changing.text: The clocks go back an hour tonight, from 03:00 to 02:00, and your phone will change by itself. Oslo bars still close at the normal time, so you don't get an extra hour out.
The city will mail every resident a brochure on preparing for war and crises in week 45, and the national preparedness week starts Monday. Oslo has its preparedness guide in English.

oslo.text: A signal fault shut the train tunnel between Nationaltheatret and Oslo S on Friday evening and messed up every line through the city. It has reopened, but check before you travel.
Oslo firefighters went out to 22 calls in two days for pots left boiling dry, so don't walk away from the stove.

be-aware.text: Storm Boelo hits southern Norway tonight. There's a yellow warning for strong gusts in parts of Østlandet, and an orange flood warning for large areas west of Oslo from tonight until Sunday evening.
SAS Link cabin crew go on strike from Wednesday morning. Only minor disruption is expected, but check your booking if you're flying SAS next week.

fun-and-free.text: Top pick: Oslo rock band Sykkeltyvene play a free gig at Folk i Storgata tonight at 21:00.
Avtrykk vol. 15 brings punk, emo and electronica to Hvelvet at Sentralen tonight from 21:30. Entry is free and 18+, but space is limited, so go early.
The Vålerenga Janitsjar wind band plays a radio-themed evening at Voldsløkka Scene at 18:00 today. You can get in free or buy a paid ticket.

intro: It's a windy, wet weekend, and you get an extra hour of sleep tonight.
